description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named Covid19Fragment. It provides an informational screen related to COVID-19 vaccination, including safety tips and a button to open the CoWIN portal in an external browser. The widget uses Material design components and external packages like url_launcher.

classes.name: Covid19Fragment
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the COVID-19 information screen, including safety tips and a button to book vaccination via external URL.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the COVID-19 information screen.

methods.name: _buildSafetyTip
methods.description: Helper method to generate safety tip list items with icon and text.

methods.name: _openCowin
methods.description: Handles the functionality to open the CoWIN portal URL in an external browser, displaying an error message if unable.
